description: What is the property price per m2 in a French departement or commune? Paid ($0.03 USDC): sales count, mean and median EUR/m2 for apartments and houses from the official DVF statistics (aggregates only, Licence Ouverte 2.0; Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte not covered). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/fr-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
